item.title: Customers Advised of Wastewater Overflow near 1234 Example Street
item.dc:creator: Staff Example
item.content:encoded:
KC Water crews responded to a wastewater overflow near 1234 Example Street in Kansas City, MO at 1:30 pm on Monday, October 14th, 2024, and ended at 8:00 pm the same day.

39000 total gallons spilled and entered into the Missouri River.

Buried underneath the streets of Kansas City are nearly 2,800 miles of sewer pipes.

For more information contact media@example.org.

item.title: Customers Advised of Wastewater Overflow near 5678 Sample Ave.
item.content:encoded: (Kansas City, Mo.) – KC Water responded to a wastewater overflow near 5678 Sample Ave. which started at 7:00 p.m. Friday, Sept. 30, 2022. Wastewater surfaced and entered a catch basin which leads to Brush Creek.

item.title: UPDATE: Customers Advised of Wastewater Overflow near 5678 Sample Ave.
item.content:encoded: (Kansas City, Mo.) – KC Water responded to a wastewater overflow near 5678 Sample Ave. which started at 7:00 p.m. Friday, Sept. 30, 2022, and ended at 1:30 a.m. the next day. About 2,000 gallons entered Brush Creek.

item.title: KC Water Facility Experiences Effects of Heavy Rain
item.content:encoded: (Kansas City, Mo.) – Heavy rainfall has affected operations at the Example Diversion Structure near the Buckeye Pump Station. This has caused highly diluted wastewater to spill into local waterways. The overflow, caused by heavy rainfall, began at 7:46 this morning and ended at 3:14 p.m. sending highly diluted wastewater into Rock Creek which flows into the Missouri River.

item.title: KC Water Issues Wastewater Bonds at Low Rate
item.content:encoded: KC Water sold wastewater bonds to fund work that reduces overflows.

item.title: Customers Advised of Wastewater Overflow near 4321 Example Road
item.content:encoded: KC Water crews responded to a wastewater overflow near 4321 Example Road at 10:00 am on Thursday, September 5th, 2024, and ended at 11:am the same day. The wastewater was contained and did not reach any creek.
